title: C++20 Cacheline-Aligned Atomic Ring Buffer
description: Implement a C++20 zero-allocation bounded lock-free ring buffer with 64-byte cacheline isolation to prevent false sharing.
prompt:
You are an expert C++20 systems software engineer. Implement a bounded lock-free Single-Producer Single-Consumer (SPSC) ring buffer:

Requirements:
1. Define `template<typename T, size_t Capacity> class SpscRingBuffer`.
2. Ensure head and tail atomic indexes are isolated with `alignas(64)` to eliminate false sharing.
3. Method `bool push(const T& item)`: Stores item and returns true; returns false if full with `std::memory_order_release`.
4. Method `bool pop(T& item)`: Loads item and returns true; returns false if empty with `std::memory_order_acquire`.
5. Output ONLY the production class template in a markdown code block.
